subject: Food Science
title: Intelligent Packaging
description: A quick, practical guide to Intelligent Packaging.

hook.text: Imagine a label that turns red when your chicken goes bad—no sniffing required. Intelligent packaging is making this real.

buildup.text: Intelligent packaging monitors food condition and communicates it to consumers through visual indicators or sensors.

discovery.text: Time-temperature indicators (TTIs) change color if food was ever exposed to unsafe temperatures during the cold chain.

twist.text: Traditional expiration dates are conservative estimates. Intelligent packaging shows actual freshness—reducing unnecessary waste.

climax.text: A third of all food produced globally is wasted. Intelligent packaging could prevent millions of tons of unnecessary disposal.

punchline.text: Don't guess freshness—measure it. Smart labels tell the true story.

quiz.question: How do time-temperature indicators help food safety?
options: They change color if food was exposed to unsafe temperatures
